item.title: Markdown Is the New Source Code: A Paradigm Shift for AI-Assisted Development
item.description: Disclaimer: This blog post was written with AI assistance using Claude Code. The ideas and perspectives are my own, refined through conversation with AI. The accompanying image was generated using AI tools. The way we write software is changing. Not just the tools—the fundamental structure of how we organize information for development. For the past two years, most of us have used AI assistants that autocomplete code and speed up boilerplate.
